chosen_by: validation/live_backtest.json: the development checkpoints (games before 2026-02-01) choose the variant; the test checkpoints are scored once

feed.source: public.slate_live (tools/slate/live_poll.js, ESPN scoreboard every 45 s inside the games-live.yml window)
missing: possession (treated as explicit variance v_pos, never guessed)
box score / play-by-play (no in-game shooting, turnover or foul information)

blockers: No always-on runtime writes live forecasts: GitHub Actions schedules are not a real-time service, and the existing live poller (games-live.yml) only refreshes public.slate_live, which is overwritten and pruned after 4 days, so live forecasts could not be audited afterwards.
The live feed has no possession indicator and no event timestamps; the model treats possession as explicit uncertainty and data age by fetch time only.
The checkpoint backtest covers one season (2025-26, reconstructed from substitution stints); production feed latency is unmeasured.

Enabling needs: an operator-run writer (basketball/ncaam_forecast/live_writer.js) on an always-on host polling within provider limits, ncaam_fc_config.live_enabled = 'true', and this file's enabled = true in a reviewed commit.

slow_start.use: a measured, configurable state shown beside the probability; never a penalty and not a pregame tendency (no chronological test supports one)
